preconditions.description: Contract must have sufficient token balance to trigger swapAndLiquify (>= numTokensSellToAddToLiquidity = 500000 * 10^14)
inSwapAndLiquify must be false (not currently swapping)

exploit_hint: Trigger token transfers to the contract until balance exceeds numTokensSellToAddToLiquidity threshold. This will automatically call swapAndLiquify() which internally calls swapTokensForEth() and addLiquidity(). If the Uniswap router calls fail (e.g., due to slippage, liquidity issues, or router problems), the return values are not checked. The contract will continue execution as if the swap succeeded, but ETH balance will not increase. Monitor contract ETH balance before and after transfer to detect if swap actually executed successfully.
